fact: A decree by Prime Minister Aldabaiba made e-payment an approved method for collecting state revenues and public dues, requiring Ministry of Finance treasuries and other ministries, departments and agencies to accept it alongside cash and cheques.
The Libyan prime minister said the government has adopted electronic payment as the official means of collecting government fees and dues.
The Central Bank of Libya made e-payments mandatory for all private and public revenue collectors, according to Libya Herald.
